Edged and caught - Five wickets for Saqib on his Test debut and he's chuffed to bits, gets down to do the sajda even as his teammates mob him. Sonal Dinusha c Salman Agha b Saqib Khan 20(35) [4s-3] Saqib Khan to Sonal Dinusha, THATS OUT!! Caught!! 112.5 Saqib Khan to Sonal Dinusha, no run, fuller length delivery and pushed across the left-hander, left alone 112.4 Saqib Khan to Milan Rathnayake, 1 run, Saqib keeps it full and just outside off, driven to the left of mid-off for a single Saqib, from over the wicket 112.3 Saqib Khan to Milan Rathnayake, no run, fuller length delivery outside off - Dinusha gets behind the line and defends it to the off-side 111.2 Razaullah to Sonal Dinusha, no run, beaten , fuller length delivery and holding its line outside off, Dinusha leans into the drive and is beaten on the outside edge 111.1 Razaullah to Milan Rathnayake, 1 run, on a good length and angling into the left-hander, nudged behind square on the on-side for a single Razaullah [23.0-1-127-0] is back into the attack Over 111 428-6 0 2 0 4 0 0 ( 6 runs) Sonal Dinusha 18 (28) Milan Priyanath Rathnayake 2 (8) Saqib Khan 31-4-125-4 Over Summary View all overs 110.6 Saqib Khan to Sonal Dinusha, no run, good length ball on off, Dinusha gets behind the line and defends down the pitch 110.5 Saqib Khan to Sonal Dinusha, no run, bouncer angled down, Dinusha ducks and allows to sail over. Ghori had to dive to glove the ball 110.4 4 Saqib Khan to Sonal Dinusha, FOUR , lovely shot! That's the second drive he's played off Saqib. Once again it is not an overpitch or a half volley, but Dinusha gets a good stride in and drives it on the up through extra cover. After a scratchy start, he's starting to look good.. 110.3 Saqib Khan to Sonal Dinusha, no run, back of a length outside off, Dinusha lifts his bat and lets it go 110.2 Saqib Khan to Sonal Dinusha, 2 runs, slanting down, Dinusha clips it behind square on the leg-side and races back for the second FEATURED VIDEOS
